gen-silkscreen-fs-plein: Plein reads clean and dependable, with open channels leading into every round letter. Silkscreen, by contrast, is a lo-fi retro display face with thick, glowing strokes like neon tubing, which makes the pairing instantly memorable.
gen-silkscreen-fs-roundo: Retro and lo-fi, Silkscreen spaces its blocky letters out so you can almost feel the gaps around each one. Roundo's plain sans text stays open and easy going.
gen-silkscreen-fs-spline-sans: Silkscreen brings a lo-fi, retro heading, each letter set apart like spaghetti laid out in a line. Spline Sans takes over below, approachable and contemporary, with wide gaps between its curve ends and stems.
gen-silkscreen-outfit: Silkscreen gives the heading a retro, lo-fi voice, with space around every letter you can almost feel. And Outfit, a clean sans whose curves finish well before they close, can be sized up a touch for comfort.
gen-silkscreen-plus-jakarta-sans: Precise and modern, Plus Jakarta Sans draws each curve ending well apart from its neighbor. And under the retro, spaced-out Silkscreen heading, a long stretch of text would move smoothly and without fuss.
gen-silkscreen-sora: Sora is a precise, geometric sans whose curves turn corners with no pressure swell. Sora keeps its c and s widely parted, so a long passage would run smooth beneath the retro Silkscreen heading.
gen-silkscreen-space-grotesk: Lo-fi and retro, Silkscreen spreads its spaghetti-like letters with space you can almost feel around each one. Space Grotesk's sans-serif text breathes easily beneath it.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-nunito: Nunito reads approachable and contemporary, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem and its lowercase bowls big and round. Gugi, bold and distinctive up top, makes a lively partner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Stencil cuts meet soft, tall lowercase here. Snowburst One is best at expressive, bold impact with wide bridges between letters, while Pilcrow Rounded is best at warm, steady reading with big counters.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively and neutral, with tall lowercase and bowls left unfinished on one side. Paprika, commanding above it, can sit a bit larger than the text.
